newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Nat'l Bank, government agree monetary policy.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Nat'l Bank, government agree monetary policy.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank and the Swiss government agree on current monetary policy and the prospects for next year, the government spokesman said after SNB Chairman Hans Meyer briefed the cabinet on Monday.
"The current monetary policy, in the aegis of the National Bank, is in the cabinet's view a favourable condition for an economic upswing," spokesman Achille Casanova said in a statement.

"Its positive impact (providing the necessary liquidity as well as low interest rates) has been reinforced of late by a depreciation of the Swiss franc. This creates better conditions for exports as well as for tourism," it said.
Meyer is scheduled to present the central bank's monetary policy view at a news conference in Zurich on Friday.
